anchors.first_comparator: replace the frozen recurrence state by the exact target-minus-host residual after every layer h_2 through h_7, then roll h_8:h_16 autonomously
anchors.second_comparator: replace the frozen recurrence state by the exact target-minus-host residual after every layer h_2 through h_9, then roll h_10:h_16 autonomously
anchors.state: full width-1024 mean-residual vector; this is an oracle ceiling, not a sampled statistic

decision.primary: record whether either fixed multi-anchor comparator gives final MSE <1e-8
decision.secondary: report each fraction of the established autonomous-to-all-layer-teacher MSE gap closed
decision.terminal_rule: evaluate exactly these two compute-motivated prefix endpoints; do not add or choose another endpoint from their result

rationale: h_7 and h_9 are the two fixed structured-prefix endpoints requested after the single-h7 ceiling showed that the old suffix immediately rebuilds its error; repeated local resets test whether shared prefix samples could instead supply each layer birth innovation
